scenarios.title: The chosen opponent may have a tribute creature enter with extra counters

setup.notes: Fanatic of Xenagos is a 3/3 trampler with tribute 1. B is the only opponent, so B is the chosen opponent.

decisions: A casts Fanatic of Xenagos, tapping all three lands.
Both players pass; the creature spell resolves.
As Fanatic of Xenagos enters, B pays tribute: it enters with one additional +1/+1 counter.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Fanatic of Xenagos enters the battlefield with one +1/+1 counter and is 4/4.

variants.label: declined
variants.expected: Fanatic of Xenagos enters the battlefield with no counters (3/3 before its own trigger resolves).

scenarios.forge_notes: B's tribute choice is an AI decision in Forge and has to be forced.

scenarios.title: The if-tribute-wasn't-paid trigger fires only when the opponent declined

setup.notes: Fanatic of Xenagos: when it enters, if tribute wasn't paid, it gets +1/+1 and haste until end of turn.

decisions: A casts Fanatic of Xenagos, tapping all three lands.
Both players pass; the creature spell resolves.
As Fanatic of Xenagos enters, B declines to pay tribute.
Both players pass; the enters trigger, if it fired, resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The trigger fires and resolves: Fanatic of Xenagos has no counters, is 4/4 until end of turn and has haste.

variants.label: paid
variants.delta: B pays tribute, so Fanatic of Xenagos enters with a +1/+1 counter.
variants.expected: The trigger does not fire. Fanatic of Xenagos is 4/4 from the counter and has no haste.

scenarios.forge_notes: B's tribute choice is an AI decision in Forge and has to be forced.
